title: Score, Lives, and Hearts
goal: Win adds points. Lose takes a heart.
mascot_lines: Score goes up when we do something good, like grab a coin.
Lives go down when we get hurt, like touching a spike.
When lives hit zero, the game ends, so we have to be careful.
Showing the score and lives on screen tells the player how they're doing right now.

tier2.rephrase: Match each thing that happens to what changes.

tier3.nudge: Coin → score up. Spike → heart down. Win flag → win!
